runTogetherFolder.text: Folder name "{{folder}}" runs its words together. Use "{{replacement}}" instead. A mind reading cold reads `format_options` at a glance and has to stop and parse `formatoptions`, and a folder's name is read on every import line and every path, so its words are separated by underscores. A name that mirrors another project's keeps it through a //cohere:ignore directly above this package clause, naming whose name it is.

runTogetherPackageName.text: Package name "{{package}}" runs its words together. Use "{{replacement}}" instead. A mind reading cold reads `format_options` at a glance and has to stop and parse `formatoptions`, and a caller reads the package name before every exported name it uses, so its words are separated by underscores.
